**_Burial_**. The target is entombed far beneath the earth in a sphere of magical force that is just large enough to contain the target. Nothing can pass through the sphere, nor can any creature teleport or use planar travel to get into or out of it.

The special component for this version of the spell is a small mithral orb.

**_Chaining_**. Heavy chains, firmly rooted in the ground, hold the target in place. The target is restrained until the spell ends, and it can't move or be moved by any means until then.

The special component for this version of the spell is a fine chain of precious metal.

**_Hedged Prison_**. The spell transports the target into a tiny demiplane that is warded against teleportation and planar travel. The demiplane can be a labyrinth, a cage, a tower, or any similar confined structure or area of your choice.

The special component for this version of the spell is a miniature representation of the prison made from jade.

**_Minimus Containment_**. The target shrinks to a height of 1 inch and is imprisoned inside a gemstone or similar object. Light can pass through the gemstone normally (allowing the target to see out and other creatures to see in), but nothing else can pass through, even by means of teleportation or planar travel. The gemstone can't be cut or broken while the spell remains in effect.

The special component for this version of the spell is a large, transparent gemstone, such as a corundum, diamond, or ruby.

**_Slumber_**. The target falls asleep and can't be awoken.

The special component for this version of the spell consists of rare soporific herbs.

**_Ending the Spell_**. During the casting of the spell, in any of its versions, you can specify a condition that will cause the spell to end and release the target. The condition can be as specific or as elaborate as you choose, but the DM must agree that the condition is reasonable and has a likelihood of coming to pass. The conditions can be based on a creature's name, identity, or deity but otherwise must be based on observable actions or qualities and not based on intangibles such as level, class, or hit points.

A _[dispel magic](https://www.aidedd.org/dnd/sorts.php?vo=dispel-magic)_ spell can end the spell only if it is cast as a 9th-level spell, targeting either the prison or the special component used to create it.

You can use a particular special component to create only one prison at a time. If you cast the spell again using the same component, the target of the first casting is immediately freed from its binding.

spells.name: Storm of Vengeance
spells.description:
A churning storm cloud forms, centered on a point you can see and spreading to a radius of 360 feet. Lightning flashes in the area, thunder booms, and strong winds roar. Each creature under the cloud (no more than 5,000 feet beneath the cloud) when it appears must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 2d6 thunder damage and becomes deafened for 5 minutes.

Each round you maintain concentration on this spell, the storm produces different effects on your turn.

**Round 2**. Acidic rain falls from the cloud. Each creature and object under the cloud takes 1d6 acid damage.

**Round 3**. You call six bolts of lightning from the cloud to strike six creatures or objects of your choice beneath the cloud. A given creature or object can't be struck by more than one bolt. A struck creature must make a Dexterity saving throw. The creature takes 10d6 lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

**Round 4**. Hailstones rain down from the cloud. Each creature under the cloud takes 2d6 bludgeoning damage.

**Round 5-10**. Gusts and freezing rain assail the area under the cloud. The area becomes difficult terrain and is heavily obscured. Each creature there takes 1d6 cold damage. Ranged weapon attacks in the area are impossible. The wind and rain count as a severe distraction for the purposes of maintaining concentration on spells. Finally, gusts of strong wind (ranging from 20 to 50 miles per hour automatically disperse fog, mists, and similar phenomena in the area, whether mundane or magical.

spells.name: True Polymorph
spells.description:
Choose one creature or nonmagical object that you can see within range. You transform the creature into a different creature, the creature into a nonmagical object, or the object into a creature (the object must be neither worn nor carried by another creature). The transformation lasts for the duration, or until the target drops to 0 hit points or dies. If you concentrate on this spell for the full duration, the transformation lasts until it is dispelled.

This spell has no effect on a shapechanger or a creature with 0 hit points. An unwilling creature can make a Wisdom saving throw, and if it succeeds, it isn't affected by this spell.

**Creature into Creature**. If you turn a creature into another kind of creature, the new form can be any kind you choose whose challenge rating is equal to or less than the target's (or its level, if the target doesn't have a challenge rating). The target's game statistics, including mental ability scores, are replaced by the statistics of the new form. It retains its alignment and personality.

The target assumes the hit points of its new form, and when it reverts to its normal form, the creature returns to the number of hit points it had before it transformed. If it reverts as a result of dropping to 0 hit points, any excess damage carries over to its normal form. As long as the excess damage doesn't reduce the creature's normal form to 0 hit points, it isn't knocked unconscious.

The creature is limited in the actions it can perform by the nature of its new form, and it can't speak, cast spells, or take any other action that requires hands or speech, unless its new form is capable of such actions.

The target's gear melds into the new form. The creature can't activate, use, wield, or otherwise benefit from any of its equipment.

**Object into Creature**. You can turn an object into any kind of creature, as long as the creature's size is no larger than the object's size and the creature's challenge rating is 9 or lower. The creature is friendly to you and your companions. It acts on each of your turns. You decide what action it takes and how it moves. The DM has the creature's statistics and resolves all of its actions and movement.

If the spell becomes permanent, you no longer control the creature. It might remain friendly to you, depending on how you have treated it.

**Creature into Object**. If you turn a creature into an object, it transforms along with whatever it is wearing and carrying into that form, as long as the object's size is no larger than the creature's size. The creature's statistics become those of the object, and the creature has no memory of time spent in this form, after the spell ends and it returns to its normal form.

spells.name: Weird

Each creature in a 30-foot-radius sphere centered on a point of your choice within range must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a creature becomes frightened for the duration. The illusion calls on the creature's deepest fears, manifesting its worst nightmares as an implac threat. At the end of each of the frightened creature's turns, it must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or take 4d10 psychic damage. On a successful save, the spell ends for that creature.

Can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without an ability check. While in contact with a web, knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web. Ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing.

features.name: Bites
features.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 0 ft., one target in the swarm's space. Hit: 10 (4d4) piercing damage, or 5 (2d4) if the swarm has half its HP or fewer.

features.name: Fey Ancestry
features.description: Advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put the drow to sleep.

features.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
features.description: While in sunlight, the drow has disadvantage on attack rolls and on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

features.name: Innate Spellcasting
features.description: CHA-based (spell save DC 11), verbal/somatic components only. At will: dancing lights. 1/day each: darkness, faerie fire.

features.name: Shortsword
features.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6+2) piercing damage.

features.name: Hand Crossbow
features.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6+2) piercing damage, plus DC 13 CON save or poisoned for 1 hour (unconscious while poisoned if the save fails by 5+; wakes on damage or being shaken awake).

features.name: Duergar Resilience
features.description: Advantage on saving throws against poison, spells, and illusions, and to resist being charmed or paralyzed.

features.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
features.description: While in sunlight, the duergar has disadvantage on attack rolls and on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

features.name: Enlarge
features.description: Recharges after a short/long rest. For 1 minute, the duergar becomes Large, doubles its STR-weapon damage dice (already reflected in its attacks below), and makes STR checks/saves with advantage.

features.name: War Pick
features.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8+2) piercing damage, or 11 (2d8+2) while enlarged.

features.name: Javelin
features.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6+2) piercing damage, or 9 (2d6+2) while enlarged.

features.name: Invisibility
features.description: Recharges after a short/long rest. Turns invisible (with equipment) for up to 1 hour, as if concentrating on a spell — ends if it attacks, casts, uses Enlarge, or its concentration breaks.

features.name: Rampage
features.description: When the gnoll reduces a creature to 0 HP with a melee attack on its turn, it can use a bonus action to move up to half its speed and make a bite attack.

features.name: Bite
features.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 4 (1d4+2) piercing damage.

features.name: Spear
features.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6+2) piercing damage, or 6 (1d8+2) two-handed melee.

features.name: Longbow
features.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d8+1) piercing damage.

features.name: Shapechanger
features.description: As an action, polymorphs into a Small or Medium humanoid it has seen (or back). Stats stay the same except size; carried equipment doesn't transform. Reverts to its true form if it dies.

features.name: Ambusher; Surprise Attack
features.description: In the first round of combat, has advantage on attacks against any creature it surprised. If it surprises a creature and hits it with an attack in the first round, that attack deals an extra 10 (3d6) damage.

features.name: Multiattack
features.description: The doppelganger makes two slam attacks. Shown as a separate action card — no automated multiattack sequencing.

features.name: Slam
features.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6+4) bludgeoning damage.

features.name: Read Thoughts
features.description: Magically reads one creature's surface thoughts within 60 ft. (blocked by 3 ft. wood/dirt, 2 ft. stone, 2 in. metal, or thin lead). Can keep reading as long as concentration holds. Advantage on Insight/Deception/Intimidation/Persuasion against the target while reading.

features.name: Hold Breath
features.description: The lizardfolk can hold its breath for 15 minutes.

features.name: Multiattack
features.description: The lizardfolk makes two melee attacks, each with a different weapon (Bite, Heavy Club, Javelin, or Spiked Shield). Shown as separate action cards — no automated multiattack sequencing.

features.name: Bite
features.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6+2) piercing damage.

features.name: Heavy Club
features.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6+2) bludgeoning damage.

features.name: Javelin
features.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6+2) piercing damage.

features.name: Spiked Shield
features.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6+2) piercing damage.

features.name: Blood Frenzy; Limited Amphibiousness; Shark Telepathy
features.description: Advantage on melee attacks against a creature that doesn't have all its HP. Can breathe air and water, but must submerge at least once every 4 hours to avoid suffocating. Can magically command any shark within 120 ft. via limited telepathy.

features.name: Multiattack
features.description: The sahuagin makes two melee attacks: one bite and one claws-or-spear. Shown as separate action cards — no automated multiattack sequencing.

features.name: Bite
features.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4+1) piercing damage.

features.name: Claws
features.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4+1) slashing damage.

features.name: Spear
features.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6+1) piercing damage, or 5 (1d8+1) two-handed melee.

features.name: Amphibious
features.description: The merfolk can breathe air and water.

features.name: Spear
features.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d6) piercing damage, or 4 (1d8) two-handed melee.

features.name: Amphibious
features.description: The merrow can breathe air and water.

features.name: Multiattack
features.description: The merrow makes two attacks: one bite and one claws-or-harpoon (melee or thrown). Shown as separate action cards — no automated multiattack sequencing.

features.name: Bite
features.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8+4) piercing damage.

features.name: Claws
features.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d4+4) slashing damage.

features.name: Harpoon
features.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6+4) piercing damage. A Huge-or-smaller target must win a STR contest or be pulled up to 20 ft. toward the merrow.

monsters.name: Grimlock
senses: blindsight 30 ft (10 ft while deafened; blind beyond)

features.name: Blind Senses; Keen Hearing and Smell; Stone Camouflage
features.description: Can't use blindsight while deafened AND unable to smell. Advantage on Perception checks that rely on hearing or smell. Advantage on Stealth checks made to hide in rocky terrain.

features.name: Spiked Bone Club
features.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4+3) bludgeoning damage plus 2 (1d4) piercing damage.

features.name: Heated Body; Illumination
features.description: A creature that touches the azer or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 ft. takes 5 (1d10) fire damage. The azer sheds bright light in a 10-ft. radius and dim light for another 10 ft.

features.name: Warhammer
features.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8+3) bludgeoning damage (8/1d10+3 two-handed) plus 3 (1d6) fire damage (from Heated Weapons).

features.name: Standing Leap
features.description: The bulette's long jump is up to 30 ft. and its high jump is up to 15 ft., with or without a running start.

features.name: Bite
features.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 30 (4d12+4) piercing damage.

features.name: Deadly Leap
features.description: If the bulette jumps at least 15 ft. as part of its movement, it can land on its feet among one or more creatures. Each must succeed a DC 16 STR or DEX save (their choice) or be knocked prone and take 14 (3d6+4) bludgeoning plus 14 (3d6+4) slashing damage; on a success, half damage, no prone, and pushed 5 ft. out of the bulette's space.

features.name: Multiattack
features.description: The behir makes two attacks: one bite and one constrict. Shown as separate action cards — no automated multiattack sequencing.

features.name: Bite
features.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (3d10+6) piercing damage.

features.name: Constrict
features.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one Large or smaller creature. Hit: 17 (2d10+6) bludgeoning plus 17 (2d10+6) slashing damage. The target is grappled (escape DC 16, one target at a time) and restrained until the grapple ends.

features.name: Lightning Breath
features.description: Recharge 5-6. Exhales lightning in a 20-foot line, 5 ft. wide. DC 16 DEX save, 66 (12d10) lightning damage on a failure, half on a success.

features.name: Swallow
features.description: Bites a Medium-or-smaller grappled target; on a hit the target is swallowed instead (grapple ends), blinded and restrained with total cover, taking 21 (6d6) acid damage at the start of each of the behir's turns. Only one creature swallowed at a time. If the behir takes 30+ damage in one turn from the swallowed creature, it must succeed a DC 14 CON save or regurgitate them prone nearby.

features.name: Multiattack
features.description: The wyvern makes two attacks: bite + stinger, or (while flying) it can swap either for claws. Shown as separate action cards — no automated multiattack sequencing.

features.name: Bite
features.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. Hit: 11 (2d6+4) piercing damage.

features.name: Claws

features.name: Stinger
features.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. Hit: 11 (2d6+4) piercing damage, plus DC 15 CON save, 24 (7d6) poison damage on a failure, half on a success.

features.name: Keen Sight
features.description: The griffon has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

features.name: Multiattack
features.description: The griffon makes two attacks: one beak and one claws. Shown as separate action cards — no automated multiattack sequencing.

features.name: Beak
features.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8+4) piercing damage.

features.name: Claws

features.name: Multiattack
features.description: The hippogriff makes two attacks: one beak and one claws. Shown as separate action cards — no automated multiattack sequencing.

features.name: Beak
features.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d10+3) piercing damage.

features.name: Claws
features.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6+3) slashing damage.

monsters.name: Pegasus
languages: understands Celestial, Common, Elvish, and Sylvan but can't speak

features.name: Hooves
features.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6+4) bludgeoning damage.

features.name: Charge
features.description: If the unicorn moves at least 20 ft. straight toward a target and hits it with a Horn attack the same turn, that attack deals an extra 9 (2d8) piercing damage; a creature target must also succeed a DC 15 STR save or be knocked prone.

features.name: Magic Resistance; Magic Weapons
features.description: Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects. The unicorn's weapon attacks are magical.

features.name: Innate Spellcasting
features.description: CHA-based (spell save DC 14), no components required. At will: detect evil and good, druidcraft, pass without trace. 1/day each: calm emotions, dispel evil and good, entangle.

features.name: Multiattack
features.description: The unicorn makes two attacks: one hooves and one horn. Shown as separate action cards — no automated multiattack sequencing.

features.name: Hooves
features.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6+4) bludgeoning damage.

features.name: Horn
features.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8+4) piercing damage.

features.name: Healing Touch (3/Day)
features.description: Touches a creature with its horn: it regains 11 (2d8+2) HP, and all diseases are cured and all poisons neutralized.

features.name: Teleport (1/Day)
features.description: Teleports itself and up to three willing creatures within 5 ft. (with equipment) to a familiar location up to 1 mile away.

features.name: Bite
features.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6+3) slashing plus 3 (1d6) acid damage. A Large-or-smaller target is grappled (escape DC 13); while grappling, the ankheg can only bite that creature, with advantage.

features.name: Acid Spray
features.description: Recharge 6. Only usable while not grappling. Spits acid in a 30-foot line, 5 ft. wide. DC 13 DEX save, 10 (3d6) acid damage on a failure, half on a success.

features.name: Bite
features.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 3 (1d4+1) piercing damage, plus DC 11 CON save against being magically petrified: on a failure the creature is restrained and turning to stone, repeating the save at the end of its next turn (success ends the effect, a second failure petrifies it for 24 hours).

features.name: Iron Scent
features.description: The rust monster can pinpoint, by scent, the location of ferrous metal within 30 ft.

features.name: Rust Metal
features.description: Any nonmagical metal weapon that hits the rust monster corrodes, taking a permanent cumulative -1 damage penalty (destroyed at -5). Nonmagical metal ammunition that hits it is destroyed after dealing damage.

features.name: Bite
features.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d8+1) piercing damage.

features.name: Antennae
features.description: Corrodes a nonmagical ferrous metal object it can see within 5 ft. — destroys a 1-ft. cube if unworn/uncarried; a wearer/carrier can attempt a DC 11 DEX save to avoid it. Touched metal armor/shield takes a permanent -1 AC penalty (destroyed at AC 10 or +0 bonus); a touched held metal weapon rusts as per Rust Metal.

features.name: Amphibious
features.description: The hag can breathe air and water.

features.name: Innate Spellcasting
features.description: CHA-based (spell save DC 12), verbal/somatic components only. At will: dancing lights, minor illusion, vicious mockery.

features.name: Mimicry
features.description: Can mimic animal sounds and humanoid voices; a listener can tell they're imitations with a successful DC 14 WIS (Insight) check.

features.name: Claws
features.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8+4) slashing damage.

features.name: Illusory Appearance
features.description: Covers herself (and gear) with an illusion resembling another humanoid-shaped creature of similar size — ends on a bonus action or her death. Fails physical inspection; a visual inspector needs a DC 20 INT (Investigation) check to see through it.

features.name: Invisible Passage
features.description: Turns invisible (with gear) until she attacks, casts, or her concentration ends, as if concentrating on a spell. Leaves no physical trace while invisible.

features.name: Magic Resistance
features.description: The hag has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

features.name: Innate Spellcasting
features.description: CHA-based (spell save DC 14, +6 to hit), verbal/somatic components only. At will: detect magic, magic missile. 2/day each: plane shift (self only), ray of enfeeblement, sleep.

features.name: Night Hag Items
features.description: Carries two very rare, self-crafted magic items she'll go to great lengths to recover if lost. Heartstone (30 days to craft): lets her go ethereal while possessed, and its touch cures any disease. Soul Bag (7 days + a humanoid sacrifice to craft): captures the soul of an evil humanoid killed by her Nightmare Haunting; holds one soul at a time, usable only by its crafter.

features.name: Claws (Hag Form Only)
features.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8+4) slashing damage.

features.name: Change Shape
features.description: Polymorphs into a Small or Medium female humanoid (or back). Stats stay the same; carried gear doesn't transform. Reverts to her true form if she dies.

features.name: Etherealness
features.description: Moves between the Material and Ethereal Planes — requires possessing her Heartstone.

features.name: Nightmare Haunting (1/Day)
features.description: While Ethereal, magically touches a sleeping humanoid on the Material Plane (blocked by protection from evil and good or magic circle). Sustained contact gives dreadful visions; after 1+ hours the target gets no rest benefit and its HP maximum drops by 5 (1d10) — lasting until removed by greater restoration or similar. If this reduces max HP to 0, the target dies (an evil target's soul is trapped in her Soul Bag).

features.name: Amphibious
features.description: The hag can breathe air and water.

features.name: Horrific Appearance
features.description: A humanoid that starts its turn within 30 ft. and can see her true form must succeed a DC 11 WIS save or be frightened for 1 minute (repeatable each turn, with disadvantage while she's in sight; success grants 24-hour immunity). A target not surprised can avert its eyes to skip the save, at the cost of disadvantage on attacks against her until its next turn.

features.name: Claws
features.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6+3) slashing damage.

features.name: Death Glare
features.description: Targets one frightened creature within 30 ft. that can see her. If that target fails a DC 11 WIS save, it drops to 0 HP.

features.name: Illusory Appearance
features.description: Covers herself (and gear) with an illusion making her look like an ugly but humanoid-shaped creature — ends on a bonus action or her death. Fails physical inspection; a visual inspector needs a DC 16 INT (Investigation) check to see through it.

features.name: Magic Resistance
features.description: The satyr has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

features.name: Ram
features.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (2d4+1) bludgeoning damage.

features.name: Shortsword
features.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6+3) piercing damage.

features.name: Shortbow
features.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6+3) piercing damage.

features.name: Longsword
features.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 slashing damage.

features.name: Shortbow
features.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range 40/160 ft., one target. Hit: 1 piercing damage, plus DC 10 CON save or poisoned for 1 minute (unconscious for the same duration if the save fails by 5+; wakes on damage or being shaken awake).

features.name: Heart Sight
features.description: Touches a creature to learn its current emotional state; if it fails a DC 10 CHA save, also learns its alignment (celestials, fiends, and undead auto-fail).

features.name: Invisibility
features.description: Turns invisible (with gear) until it attacks or casts a spell, or until its concentration ends, as if concentrating on a spell.

monsters.name: Blink Dog
languages: Blink Dog (understands Sylvan but can't speak it)

features.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
features.description: Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

features.name: Bite
features.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6+1) piercing damage.

features.name: Teleport
features.description: Recharge 4-6. Teleports up to 40 ft. (with gear) to an unoccupied space it can see; can make one bite attack before or after teleporting.

features.name: False Appearance; Siege Monster
features.description: While motionless, indistinguishable from a normal tree. Deals double damage to objects and structures.

features.name: Multiattack
features.description: The treant makes two slam attacks. Shown as a separate action card — no automated multiattack sequencing.

features.name: Slam
features.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (3d6+6) bludgeoning damage.

features.name: Rock
features.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, range 60/180 ft., one target. Hit: 28 (4d10+6) bludgeoning damage.

features.name: Animate Trees (1/Day)
features.description: Animates one or two trees within 60 ft. into treant-statistic allies (INT/CHA 1, mute, Slam-only). Lasts 1 day, or until it dies, the treant is 120+ ft. away, or the treant uses a bonus action to revert it (then it roots if possible).

monsters.name: Chuul
languages: understands Deep Speech but can't speak

features.name: Amphibious; Sense Magic
features.description: Can breathe air and water. Senses magic within 120 ft. at will, like detect magic but not itself magical.

features.name: Multiattack
features.description: The chuul makes two pincer attacks; if it's grappling a creature, it can also use Tentacles once. Shown as separate action cards — no automated multiattack sequencing.

features.name: Pincer
features.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6+4) bludgeoning damage. A Large-or-smaller target is grappled (escape DC 14) unless the chuul already has two others grappled.

features.name: Tentacles
features.description: One creature grappled by the chuul must succeed a DC 13 CON save or be poisoned for 1 minute (and paralyzed while poisoned this way); it repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

features.name: Damage Transfer
features.description: While attached to a creature, the cloaker takes only half of any damage dealt to it (rounded down) and that creature takes the other half.

features.name: False Appearance
features.description: While motionless with its underside hidden, indistinguishable from a dark leather cloak.

features.name: Light Sensitivity
features.description: While in bright light, has disadvantage on attack rolls and on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

features.name: Multiattack
features.description: The cloaker makes two attacks: one bite and one tail. Shown as separate action cards — no automated multiattack sequencing.

features.name: Bite
features.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 10 (2d6+3) piercing damage; a Large-or-smaller target becomes attached (attached to the head — blinded and unable to breathe — if the cloaker had advantage). While attached, the cloaker can only bite that target, with advantage; it can detach by spending 5 ft. of movement, and any creature can detach it with a DC 16 STR check.

features.name: Tail
features.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. Hit: 7 (1d8+3) slashing damage.

features.name: Moan
features.description: Each non-aberration within 60 ft. that can hear it must succeed a DC 13 WIS save or be frightened until the end of the cloaker's next turn (success grants 24-hour immunity).

features.name: Phantasms
features.description: Recharges after a short/long rest. Not usable in bright light. Creates three illusory duplicates that move and act with it, indistinguishable at range; an attacker rolls randomly to hit the real cloaker or a duplicate (unaffected if they can't see or use non-sight senses). A duplicate shares the cloaker's AC/saves and vanishes if hit or if it fails a damaging save. Duplicates disappear in bright light.

features.name: Echolocation; False Appearance
features.description: Can't use blindsight while deafened. While motionless, indistinguishable from a cave formation such as a stalactite or stalagmite.

features.name: Crush
features.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 6 (1d6+3) bludgeoning damage; the darkmantle attaches (engulfing a Medium-or-smaller target's head — blinding it and stopping it breathing — if it had advantage). While attached, the darkmantle can only attack that target, with advantage, and has speed 0. A creature can detach it with a DC 13 STR check; the darkmantle itself can detach by spending 5 ft. of movement.

features.name: Darkness Aura (1/Day)
features.description: Spreads 15-foot-radius magical darkness around itself (moves with it, wraps corners) for up to 10 minutes as if concentrating on a spell. Blocks darkvision and natural light; dispels any overlapping 2nd-level-or-lower light spell.

features.name: Aberrant Ground
features.description: The ground in a 10-foot radius around the mouther is doughlike difficult terrain. Each creature starting its turn there must succeed a DC 10 STR save or have its speed reduced to 0 until the start of its next turn.

features.name: Gibbering
features.description: While it can see a creature and isn't incapacitated, the mouther babbles incoherently. Each creature starting its turn within 20 ft. and able to hear it must succeed a DC 10 WIS save or lose reactions until its next turn and roll a d8 for its turn: 1-4 does nothing, 5-6 moves in a random direction using all movement (no action/bonus action), 7-8 makes a melee attack against a random creature in reach (or nothing if it can't).

features.name: Multiattack
features.description: The mouther makes one bite attack and, if able, uses Blinding Spittle. Shown as separate action cards — no automated multiattack sequencing.

features.name: Bites
features.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 17 (5d6) piercing damage. A Medium-or-smaller target must succeed a DC 10 STR save or be knocked prone. A creature killed by this damage is absorbed into the mouther.

features.name: Blinding Spittle
features.description: Recharge 5-6. Spits a glob up to 15 ft. away that explodes in a blinding flash. Each creature within 5 ft. of the flash must succeed a DC 13 DEX save or be blinded until the end of the mouther's next turn.

features.name: Limited Telepathy
features.description: Can magically transmit simple messages and images to any creature within 120 ft. that understands a language (one-way — no reply).

features.name: Multiattack
features.description: The otyugh makes three attacks: one bite and two tentacles. Shown as separate action cards — no automated multiattack sequencing.

features.name: Bite
features.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8+3) piercing damage. features.name: Tentacle

conditions.description: A stunned creature is incapacitated, can't move, and can speak only falteringly. It automatically fails STR and DEX saves. Attack rolls against it have advantage.

features.name: Stunned
features.description: Speed is reduced to 0.

conditions.name: Unconscious
conditions.description: An unconscious creature is incapacitated, can't move or speak, and is unaware of its surroundings. The creature drops whatever it's holding and falls prone. It automatically fails STR and DEX saves. Attack rolls against it have advantage and are critical hits within 5 feet.

features.name: Unconscious
features.description: Speed is reduced to 0.
